sentences.text: For Respondents: Mr.N.Naveenkumar  Government Advocate  ORDER

The petitioner is the owner of the portion of the property situated in old Survey Nos.44/1, 45/2 and 46 of Thirumurgan Nagar, Murugamangalam Village, Keerapakkam Village Panchayat,
Kattankulathur Panchayat Union, Chengalpattu Taluk & District.
The grievance of the petitioner is that the 2 nd respondent had laid a culvert over his property to an extent of 1688 sq.ft, out of total extent of 2938 sq.ft.
He has called upon the respondents either to remove the culvert or to pay compensation as per the Land Acquisition Laws.
3. Mr.N.Naveenkumar, took notice on behalf of the respondents 1 to 4.

I called upon him to instruct the 3rd respondent to conduct survey of the aforesaid property and to demarcate the holdings of the petitioner and to find out whether the culvert has been constructed over the petitioners property.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
4. When the matter was taken up today, Mr.N.Naveenkumar, has filed status report of the 2nd respondent.

The same is scanned and extracted hereunder:
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

( Uploaded on: 09/02/2026 01:35:52 pm )
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 09/02/2026 01:35:52 pm )
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

5. A perusal of the same shows that the 2 nd respondent has agreed to remove the culvert constructed over the petitioners land to an extent of 979 sq.ft. and restore and handover the same to the petitioner.
6. Mr.Naveenkumar states that needful will be done within two weeks.
The said statement is recorded.
7. The Writ Petition is ordered accordingly.
No costs.

8. Post For Reporting Compliance on 18.02.2026.
04-02-2026
